summary: BMW Auto Leasing LLC, as depositor, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for BMW Vehicle Lease Trust 2026-2, a $1.25 billion auto-lease asset-backed note offering. Five classes price from 4.325% (A-1, $223M) to 5.30% (A-4, $65.8M), with A-2b ($175M) floating at SOFR plus 0.37%. Underwriting discounts range 0.035%-0.250%. Credit enhancement combines overcollateralization, a reserve fund and excess cashflow. Settlement is expected on or about October 14, 2026, first payment November 25, 2026. BofA, BNP Paribas and US Bancorp are joint bookrunners. This is routine term ABS supply, not a special situation; watch spread and collateral performance.
